title: The app over the board's USB serial port
summary: The APK reaches the board through its USB serial port with a cable from the phone, every command line it sends over Wi-Fi sent there with the same replies, so every screen and job works on either link; log lines beginning with # are passed over, the port is opened RTS then DTR lowered so the chip is never reset, the device found by 303a:1001 with Android's permission. The Target screen gets one 'Connect over Wi-Fi' control in place of the duplicate Use and Board buttons, and a kept switch Wi-Fi / USB serial; the emulator's page shows USB serial disabled. No command, reply, firmware, wiring or power change; firmware installation stays where it is.
